import re,sys,hashlib
src,tgt,want,out=sys.argv[1:5]

idre=re.compile(rb'^\s*<id>(.*?)</id>')
ins={}  # T line idx -> bytes lines

for i,l in enumerate(T):
    m=idre.match(l)
    if m: tidx.setdefault((m.group(1),ind(l)),[]).append(i)
miss=0;multi=0;done=0
i=0
while i<len(S):
    if b'<li Class="Asimov.Need_Energy">' in S[i]:
        n=ind(S[i]); j=i
        # find inner needs open, position k
        k=0
        while True:
            j-=1
            if ind(S[j])==n and S[j].lstrip().startswith(b'<li'): k+=1
            if ind(S[j])==n-1: break
        nest=S[j].strip()
        h=j

            h-=1
            m=idre.match(S[h])
            if m and ind(S[h])<=n-1: break
        pid=m.group(1); pl=ind(S[h])
        block=S[i:i+4]
        c=tidx.get((pid,pl),[])
        if not c: miss+=1; print('MISS',pid,pl); i+=4; continue
        if len(c)>1: multi+=1

        while not (ind(T[p])==n-1 and T[p].strip()==nest): p+=1
        q=p+1;seen=0
        while True:
            if ind(T[q])==n and T[q].lstrip().startswith(b'<li'):
                if seen==k: break
                seen+=1
            if ind(T[q])==n-1 and T[q].lstrip().startswith(b'</'): break
            q+=1
        ins.setdefault(q,[]).extend(block); done+=1; i+=4; continue
    i+=1
print('done',done,'miss',miss,'multi',multi)
R=[]
for i,l in enumerate(T):
    if i in ins: R.extend(ins[i])
    R.append(l)
b=b'\n'.join(R); h=hashlib.sha1(b).hexdigest(); print(len(b),h,'MATCH' if h==want else 'no')
open(out,'wb').write(b)
E
